name: @kud/mcp-opencode

tools.name: query
tools.description: Send a prompt to an opencode model. Defaults to github-copilot/gpt-4.1. Filters — allow: all. Use list_models to see what's available.

model.description: Model to use in provider/model format (default: github-copilot/gpt-4.1)

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List models available for use. Without a provider, returns providers with model counts. Pass a provider name to list its models. Respects allow/block filters (allow: all).

provider.description: Provider name to filter by (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai'). Omit to list all providers.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List sessions on the running opencode server (http://127.0.0.1:4096), most recently updated first. Use this to find a live session — e.g. one open in the opencode TUI — to talk to with send.

directory.description: Only list sessions for this project directory

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a message to an existing opencode session and return its reply. The session keeps its history and model, and the exchange appears live in any attached opencode TUI. Never creates or deletes sessions. Model allow/block filters do not apply: the session's own model is used.

agent.description: opencode agent to handle the message (e.g. 'build', 'plan')

timeout_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds (default: 600). opencode keeps working; use read to fetch the reply later.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the recent messages of an opencode session as a condensed transcript (text, with tool calls summarised).

limit.description: Number of most recent messages to return (default: 20)
